title: A hundred thousand nested flow sequences read as a value
notes: The input is valid. A library that reads it gives exactly the expected result; one that refuses it says so with a limit error. A crash, a hang, a wrong result, or more than the stated time or memory fails. The resource bounds are the robustness requirement of the kit, not a rule of the specification. This case reads the value, so a library that recurses on the way out fails here too.
